features.text: BEND-TO-FIT CONSTRUCTION: Heat-adjustable insert allows precise customization to individual wrist, hand, and finger positioning needs.
STATIC THERAPY SUPPORT: Provides stable alignment for managing mild to moderate contractures and thumb adduction.
FUNCTIONAL HAND ALIGNMENT: Positions wrist and fingers in a natural resting posture to support tissue health and mobility.
SOFT COMFORT LINING: Cushioned, breathable materials protect skin and improve tolerance during prolonged wear.
EASY STRAP APPLICATION: Color-coded straps make fitting and adjustments simple for clinicians and caregivers.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: Mild to moderate contracture of the wrist, hand, and fingers
